claims.explanation: Zolantidine is a brain-penetrant histamine H2 receptor antagonist that, unlike H1 antagonists, does not block the anticonvulsant/protective effects of histamine in CNS models. Its selective anticancer activity may reflect dependence on H2 receptor signaling or histamine metabolism in certain tumor lineages, particularly those with RAS/RAF pathway activation and neural/neuroendocrine features. The pattern of sensitive lines (melanoma, glioma, neuroblastoma, NSCLC, gastric) suggests that tumors with MAPK pathway mutations and high histamine receptor expression are more vulnerable.
